scientific_integrity.claim_domain: Finite binary hypercubes with uniform coherent adjacency hopping and strictly positive absorber strengths on complete Hamming spheres; exact single-shell rank and even-dimension paired-layer full-capture theorem.
scientific_integrity.limitations: The optimization concerns the number of complete Hamming spheres, not arbitrary absorber sites. No finite-time decay-rate bound, dephasing, disorder or full open-system Lindbladian claim is made.
scientific_integrity.proof_status: Mathematical derivation supplied with finite exact corroboration; no independent scientific validation has been performed.

title: Parity-sharp coherent absorption by Hamming spheres on quantum hypercubes
